subject: POC Rallyboard: scheduling alignment & success criteria

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:15:00-08:00
Subject: POC Rallyboard: scheduling alignment & success criteria

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking a look at Redwood. We'd like to lock in a 90-minute POC kickoff to align on success criteria, owners, and the high-level timeline so your engineers have a clear runbook for the pilot. Proposed agenda:

- Intro & goals (10m)
- Environment & network checklist (15m)
- Demo: integration flow + sample workload (25m)
- Success criteria & acceptance tests (20m)
- Procurement / SOW timeline and next steps (15m)
- Q&A & actions (5m)

Two slots that work for our team:
- Thu Dec 9, 9:30–11:00 AM PST
- Fri Dec 10, 11:00–12:30 PM PST

Could you confirm which works and who from Aurelia should attend? Please include your procurement and security leads if possible — we want procurement to confirm SOW milestones and security to sign off on any data flow constraints.

Attachments: I have a one-page POC success criteria and a slot matrix attached for you to indicate preferred times.

If either slot doesn't work, suggest 2 alternative windows next week and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- POC_Success-Criteria.pdf (application/pdf)
- Rallyboard-Slot-Matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Chloe —

Thanks for the overview and proposed agenda. Both look good. Our engineering leads are tied up the mornings you suggested. Would you be able to do Thu Dec 16, 10:00–11:30 AM PST instead? That slot keeps our West Coast engineers in overlap with our Mumbai security folks.

Please loop in procurement (procurement@aureliasys.com) and our security lead Kunal Bhatt (kunal.b@aureliasys.com) — they'll want to see SOC2 and SSO integration notes before the meeting. Also, we need a draft SOW or list of billable items ahead of the kickoff so procurement can estimate internal approvals.

Attaching a short note with the names of the people who should join from Aurelia.

Best,

Hi Priya —

Thu Dec 16, 10:00–11:30 AM PST works for us. I've penciled it in tentatively on our side.

For clarity on roles during the meeting:
- Avery Johnson (AE) will run the mutual action plan and procurement questions.
- Dev Patel (SE) will lead the demo and cover integration checklist (network ports, SSO, test dataset ingestion).
- I'll facilitate the acceptance criteria discussion and owners for each item.

Attached: the one-page POC success criteria and the slot matrix (so you can mark any other constraints). Key acceptance criteria we propose:
1) Functional: end-to-end generation against a sample workload with acceptable latency (p90 under 450ms for target queries).
2) Integration: CI-based token refresh + SSO integration validated in staging within the pilot window.
3) Security & compliance: SOC2 evidence and a signed data handling addendum or equivalent.
4) Procurement: SOW signed or execution plan with milestone dates for production roll.

Could Kunal confirm whether we should provision a staging VPC or whether Aurelia prefers an IP allowlist + mutual TLS? That decision affects the demo prep.

I'll put a calendar invite once we have confirmation of the attendee list.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Chloe
